queries_run: Meta Platforms product substitute technology threat 2026
AI chatbots disrupt social media advertising ChatGPT threat to Meta 2026

findings.claim: Meta 10-K 自述：部分用戶（尤其年輕用戶）已使用類似或可替代其產品的其他產品，並減少使用 Meta 產品。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We believe that some users, particularly younger users, are aware of and actively engaging with other products and services similar to, or as a substitute for, our products and services, and we believe that some users have reduced their use of and engagement with our products and services in favor of these other products and services.

findings.claim: Meta 10-K 將其業務描述為快速變動、有顛覆性技術，並列出與 AI 前沿模型開發及 AR/VR 消費硬體業者的競爭。
findings.excerpt: Our business is characterized by innovation, rapid change, and disruptive technologies.

substitute_technology.note: 兩次搜尋未找到 2026 年具名的替代技術（如 AI 聊天機器人廣告）可逐字引用的來源；僅有 2025 年舊報導摘要，未列入。
